name: Edrisil Mune
source:
“If it’s something that can make him happy, I’ll protect it for him.”

Is the pen mightier than the sword? Those who have underestimated Mune will tell you that, when it comes to her, it hardly matters: your feelings and your bones will both end up in shambles.

[From [url=https://herchoicevn.tumblr.com/edrisil-mune]official bio[/url]]
